description: Long-hall feed for tom fills. Layers onto tom-fill; programs no inserts. Long tail FX dialed once on the FX track.
name: tom-long
notes: Precondition: Tom track selected; Tom send slot 1 assigned to the long hall FX (same destination as Drums slot 1, one-time setup). Apply tom-fill first, then this.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Feature fills take more; groove fills take less or bypass via on 0.
